body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its organic LED TV 'XEL-1' at the 2009 International CES in Las Vegas, which features 3mm-thin display and contrast ratio greater than 1,000,000 to 1.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
